measurementSequence: Try a heat-retention experimentCovering changes how heat and vapor escape in this teaching model. Placement itself changes no water temperature. Take a thermometer check, cover the pot, and advance a short shared-clock step with the burner setting steady. Lift the lid onto its rest, then take another check to compare.
